full_script: [thoughtful] Frases reales, de las que se usan de verdad. Dilas antes que yo. Can you hear me? You're on mute. You're breaking up. Can you see my screen? Sorry, I froze. Let me share my screen. Could you say that again? I'm getting an echo. I think we lost the connection. I have to jump on another call. [excited] Compártelo con alguien que las necesite.
